scope: design only; no participants, hosts, transcript search or production edits
informed_by: R32 (accepted: both primary FAIL; routing T PASS / C FAIL; grounding T FAIL / C PASS). R32 grades and outcome definition unchanged; no retrospective regrade.

pairs.L: collect a bounded diagnostic log bundle
pairs.V: verify a deployed configuration against a supplied expected setting

arms.control:
tasks/

-control.md = nudge + 'No saved notes for this session.' + common
arms.treatment:
tasks/

-treatment.md = nudge + R30 memory-packet.md verbatim + common

contrast: only the saved packet differs; common task asks neutrally who runs each step on which machine; no owner/routing answer; no lesson-bearing additions (no after-df task, no grounding hint beyond R30's shared 'name unknowns' line)
shared_cues: name unknowns; do not claim results you did not observe
primary_targeted: routing (rubric.md); motivated by R32, declared here before any R33 participant
net: strict all-axes success per arm and pair
order_method: secrets draw at author time (order.json); 3 pairs, first arm T,C,T or C,T,C

execution_proposal.per_arm: 10m worker + 5m verify, fresh R10 /new, idle check
execution_proposal.operator_preflight: sha256 of explicit paths: /home/bmosher/.local/bin/agent-loop and /home/bmosher/.config/agent-deck/acp-worker (never hash empty stdin); one check
execution_proposal.activation: none from design PASS; Tern must release

limits: prior design exposure is not none
shared cues may let control infer routing; not suppressed
